value.rationale: Thomas and Namboothiri (2023) pose the quantitative maximal-sum problem. The exact sharp maximum is only one implication: all prefix values form p^(2s) disjoint-band points independent of q and both exponents, every value has explicit nontrivial frequency, and all prefixes after the sharp HQ cutoff are negative. This infinite natural two-prime classification provides a useful structural boundary for higher-support inclusion-exclusion. Short proof is a strength but also narrows the contribution; no wider claim is made.
